# Code Anchors: Component Migration

- `libs/portable-tools/src/migrate-components.ts` — the gated repository migration: the git-work-tree refusal, the tracked-file veto handed to the mirror, the widened top-level ownership match, the append-only idempotent ignore entries, and the explicitly-scoped git commands it prints.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/migrate-components.spec.ts` — end-to-end coverage: tracked files removed and left unstaged, untracked ones listed and left in place, no index write and no commit, and ignore-entry idempotency on a re-run.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the `migrate-components` verb: the install-location precondition, the location-and-content disclosure printed before any removal, and the reported counts.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-namespace.ts` — the ownership predicate this verb widens by one level, and only for itself.
